card.name: The word see in cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" right after an opening bracket in label cross-references like "[see Drug Interactions (7)]". It also fires on the period inside section numbers such as "(12.3)" after "[see Clinical Pharmacology".

modes.label: See in brackets
modes.description: The word see opens a bracketed pointer to another label section after a statement.
modes.example: can substantially decrease omeprazole concentrations [<<see>> Drug Interactions ( 7 )]

modes.label: Dot in section number
modes.description: The period inside a section number in a cross-reference, such as 12.3.
